'''''Star Tours''''' was an advertisement for the travel agency of the same name, put up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It featured an idyllic view of two [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]] posing on the [[Beach/Legends|beach]]. The all-[[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] caption translated as:

<poem><big><big><big>'''[[Star Tours|STAR<br />TOURS]]'''</big></big></big>
<big>[[Glee Anselm|GLEE ANSELM]]</big>
<small>CALL 1-800-555-6576 NOW!</small></poem>

The was featured on both giant billboards such as the one that the thief [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]] and the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] ran across when Tano chased the former through Coruscant; and on smaller billboards in the [[City/Legends|city]] streets.<ref name="Lost" />
